Full Stack .NET / React Developer – Vulnerability Remediation 
 Location:  Irving, TX (Hybrid – 3 days onsite per week) 
 Duration:  6 Month Contract with possibility to extend  
 Schedule:  Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–6 PM CST, with flexibility for after-hours deployments 
 
 Key Responsibilities / Project Purpose 
 
	 Identify, troubleshoot, and remediate security vulnerabilities across existing applications, code, dependencies, and infrastructure. 
	 Address critical vulnerabilities within a 24-hour remediation SLA. 
	 Develop, modify, and maintain applications built with  .NET and React . 
	 Troubleshoot and resolve vulnerabilities related to  Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS)  deployments and application infrastructure. 
	 Implement and deploy code fixes to production environments while minimizing application downtime. 
	 Collaborate with engineering and cybersecurity teams to prioritize and resolve security findings. 
	 Support production releases, including occasional evening and weekend deployments. 
	 Assist with automated regression testing, test case improvements, and production validation when vulnerability remediation work is not required. 
 
  Required Skills 

 
	 2+ years of professional software development experience. 
	 Hands-on experience developing and troubleshooting applications using   .NET and React . 
	 Experience working with  Azure Kubernetes services (AKS)  in a production application environment. 
	 Ability to investigate and remediate application vulnerabilities, including code-level and dependency-related security issues. 
	 Experience troubleshooting application issues and implementing fixes through production deployment. 
	 Understanding of software development lifecycles, release processes, and application testing. 
	 Ability to work independently, troubleshoot complex issues, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams. 
	 Flexibility to support occasional after-hours production releases. 
 
  Nice-to-Have Skills 

 
	 Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure cloud services. 
	 Experience with React Native. 
	 Experience with automated QA testing, regression testing, or test automation frameworks. 
	 Previous involvement in application security remediation or vulnerability management initiatives. 
	 Experience supporting production applications in cloud-based environments.
